events.title: US Retail Sales (July)
events.why_it_matters: Core gauge of US consumer health; signals resilience or softening ahead of Fed policy path.
events.what_to_watch: Control-group sales, upward revisions, online vs. in-store divergence.

events.title: US PPI (July)
events.why_it_matters: Producer prices feed into consumer inflation and Fed expectations; pipeline pressure signals.
events.what_to_watch: Core PPI, food/energy components, pass-through to CPI.

events.title: China July Activity Data (Retail Sales, IP, FAI)
events.why_it_matters: China's growth engine is key for global demand; property slump and weak consumption remain risks.
events.what_to_watch: Retail sales growth, property investment, youth unemployment, policy response signals.

events.title: Target Q2 FY2026 Earnings
events.why_it_matters: Barometer for US discount retail demand and inventory health; guides back-to-school season.
events.what_to_watch: Same-store sales, margin guidance, inventory levels, consumer traffic commentary.

events.title: Lowe's Q2 FY2026 Earnings
events.why_it_matters: Housing market and DIY spending proxy; signals consumer confidence in big-ticket purchases.
events.what_to_watch: Comparable sales, professional vs. DIY demand, housing market commentary.

events.title: FOMC July Meeting Minutes
events.why_it_matters: Details on Fed's rate-cut debate and balance sheet plans; shapes market pricing for September.
events.what_to_watch: Dovish vs. hawkish language, dissent, balance sheet runoff discussion.

events.title: Jackson Hole Economic Symposium
events.why_it_matters: Central bank communication hub; Powell's speech sets tone for global rate expectations.
events.what_to_watch: Powell's remarks on inflation, labor market, and policy path.

events.title: US Existing Home Sales (July)
events.why_it_matters: Housing market remains constrained by rates and low inventory; key for consumer wealth effect.
events.what_to_watch: Inventory levels, median prices, months of supply.

events.title: Eurozone Flash PMIs (August)
events.why_it_matters: Early read on Eurozone growth momentum; ECB policy implications.
events.what_to_watch: Services vs. manufacturing divergence, price components, Germany/France breakdown.

events.title: US Jobless Claims (Weekly)
events.why_it_matters: High-frequency labor market health check; rising claims could signal cooling.
events.what_to_watch: Trend vs. noise, continuing claims, state-level anomalies.

events.title: US New Home Sales (July)
events.why_it_matters: Housing demand signal; new home sales less rate-sensitive than existing.
events.what_to_watch: Supply, median prices, regional trends.

events.title: US Durable Goods Orders (July)
events.why_it_matters: Business investment proxy; volatile but signals capex trends.
events.what_to_watch: Core capital goods orders (ex-defense, ex-aircraft), revisions.

events.title: US Q2 GDP (Second Estimate)
events.why_it_matters: Confirms growth trajectory; revisions can shift market narrative.
events.what_to_watch: Personal consumption, inventory contribution, GDP deflator.

events.title: US PCE Price Index (July)
events.why_it_matters: Fed's preferred inflation gauge; critical for September rate decision.
events.what_to_watch: Core PCE, services inflation, supercore.

events.title: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Earnings
events.why_it_matters: AI demand bellwether; results move global tech and broader indices.
events.what_to_watch: Data center revenue, guidance, supply chain constraints, China export impact.

events.title: Salesforce Q2 FY2027 Earnings
events.why_it_matters: Enterprise software demand and AI monetization signal.
events.what_to_watch: cRPO growth, AI product adoption, margin guidance.

events.title: US Consumer Confidence (August)
events.why_it_matters: Consumer sentiment drives spending; labor market perceptions key.
events.what_to_watch: Present situation vs. expectations, inflation expectations.

events.title: China Caixin Manufacturing PMI (August)
events.why_it_matters: Private-sector manufacturing health; contrasts with official PMI.
events.what_to_watch: New orders, export orders, employment sub-indices.

events.title: OPEC+ Meeting
events.why_it_matters: Production quotas affect oil prices and global inflation.
events.what_to_watch: Quota changes, compliance, demand outlook commentary.

events.title: US Nonfarm Payrolls (August)
events.why_it_matters: Key labor market indicator; determines Fed easing pace.
events.what_to_watch: Headline jobs, unemployment rate, wage growth, revisions.

events.title: US CPI (August)
events.why_it_matters: Final major inflation print before September FOMC.
events.what_to_watch: Core CPI, shelter, services inflation.

events.title: US Presidential Election Campaign Events
events.why_it_matters: Policy uncertainty rises ahead of midterms; market positioning shifts.
events.what_to_watch: Polling shifts, policy proposals, debate schedules.

events.title: Russia-Ukraine Conflict Developments
events.why_it_matters: Energy security, grain exports, and NATO tensions persist.
events.what_to_watch: Frontline changes, energy infrastructure attacks, diplomatic talks.

events.title: China-Taiwan Tensions
events.why_it_matters: Semiconductor supply chain risk; potential for escalation.
events.what_to_watch: Military exercises, diplomatic statements, chip export controls.

events.title: Middle East Conflict / Red Sea Shipping
events.why_it_matters: Shipping disruptions and oil price risk persist.
events.what_to_watch: Attacks on vessels, insurance rates, oil price response.

top_risks: US inflation reacceleration forcing Fed to delay cuts
China property crisis deepening and dragging global growth
AI capex disappointment triggering tech selloff
Consumer spending slowdown hitting retail earnings
Oil price spike from OPEC+ supply cuts or geopolitical shock
top_opportunities: Rate-sensitive sectors (housing, small caps) if Fed signals cuts
AI infrastructure beneficiaries ahead of NVIDIA earnings
Consumer staples and discount retail if consumer weakens
Gold and commodities as hedge against geopolitical risk
summary: The week ahead is dense with macro data and earnings. US retail sales and PPI came in mixed, while China's activity data showed continued weakness. Key upcoming catalysts include FOMC minutes, Jackson Hole, NVIDIA earnings, and the PCE inflation print. Geopolitical risks (Taiwan, Middle East, Russia-Ukraine) remain elevated. Markets are likely to be driven by Fed communication and AI sentiment.
